items.name: core
items.title: OIDC Core
items.description: A starter policy form: GitHub Actions and Vercel behind a toggle picker, each form with its own submit. The file is yours — add providers, swap the picker, and wire onSubmit to your storage. The builder at the homepage generates this file for any provider combination.

items.name: policy
items.title: OIDC Policy Contract
items.description: The OidcPolicy rule type, its matching semantics, validation, and the match/explain functions. No dependencies — the foundation every other oidc-ui item builds on.

items.name: verify
items.title: OIDC Verifier
items.description: Server-side token verification against OidcPolicy rules: OIDC discovery with issuer assertion, JWKS caching with stale fallback, signature and expiry checks via jose, and named error codes. Claim matching comes from @oidc/policy.

items.name: claims
items.title: OIDC Claims Pieces
items.description: The shared pieces every provider form composes: the ClaimsList row editor for additional claims, the ClaimChip label marker, and the pure helpers that merge rows into a policy and read them back out.

items.name: picker
items.title: OIDC Picker
items.description: Single-select provider picker that adapts to the count: a toggle row for up to three providers, a select beyond that, nothing for one.

items.name: page-actions
items.title: OIDC Settings Page
items.description: A working settings page: app/settings/oidc renders the policy form, and a server action validates with validateOidcPolicy before saving. Wire the form's onSubmit to savePolicy and replace the console.log with your storage.
